messages:
Marta: Quick sync - sketching an autofallback playbook for rollouts. Need consensus on triggers, degrade modes, and operator actions (preview/force/rollback).

Jon: Keep triggers minimal: infra 5xx spikes, p95 latency breaches, model aborts, dedicated pool exhaustion.

Amy: For pool exhaustion show pool name + fallback target and a rough cost delta. Support will ask.

Sam: UI idea: one-line trigger rows with last-fired, sample request link, and a small "Sim 1%" button that runs a non-destructive preview returning sim hist + audit sample.

Hina: Audit must be structured: trigger, metrics_at_fire, policy_id, fallback_target, operator_action, operator_id, operator_note. Retention default 90d. Add "Why did this fallback" deeplink.

Marta: Hysteresis required to prevent flapping. Propose knobs: cooldown_sec, min_serve_sec, max_swaps_per_min. Defaults 60/120/2; Dedicated gets higher min_serve.

Jon: Add flapping detector that pauses auto-swaps and flags policy for manual review when swaps exceed threshold.

Amy: Force/rollback UI should show impacted routes and cost delta, require a short reason; still emit audit with operator_action.

Marta: Draft policy example (compact): policy_id=rbx-auto-1, triggers=[infra_5xx:60s>5, latency_p95:300s>1000ms], degrade_mode=fallback_variant, fallback_target=gptq-medium-v1, hysteresis={cooldown:60,min:120,max_swaps:2}.

Sam: I'll wire rollout-sandbox sim into the modal. Keyboard shortcuts behind flag: p=preview, f=force, r=rollback.

Hina: I'll publish audit schema and export endpoints; include audit_sample_id to tie sim<>real.

Deploy Bot: deploy notice - branch autofallback-playbook -> staging (sha def456).

Marta: Action items: 1) mock matrix + modal, 2) Jon: flapping tests, 3) Amy: cost calc, 4) Hina: audit schema. Back in 48h. :thumbsup:
